# OpenICPSR E112992

Replication package for Bagde–Epple–Taylor (AER 2016).

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.3886/E112992V1
- Status (2026-07-25): project page is public, but **download requires a free ICPSR/OpenICPSR login**.
- Action: create account, accept terms, download project zip into this `raw/` folder, then run `scripts/register_download.py`.
